description: Find the 3D model of a KiCad library footprint. Give an exact footprint id ('Package_SO:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm', as datasheetvend_match_kicad_footprint returns it) or words that must all appear in the id ('QFN-32 5x5 P0.5'). For each footprint: the model files it points to, the path as KiCad writes it, the offset, scale and rotation the footprint applies, and in_library: whether that file really ships in KiCad's 3D library. Many footprints name a model that does NOT exist there; those come back as model_missing, not as a model. Answers for ONE KiCad release, stated in the answer. It does NOT serve the model files (it says where they are), does NOT read geometry (no height, no outline), and does NOT choose a footprint for a chip. A model is the library's drawing of a package, not the manufacturer's. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, no network at call time, reads no account data.

footprint.description: A footprint id 'Library:Name', or words that must all be in the id. At least 3 characters.

name: datasheetvend_find_kicad_3d_model
title: Find a KiCad footprint's 3D model
